learning_outcomes.text: Explain the basic principles of logistics.
Apply methods and tools for optimizing internal material flow.
Systematically analyze material flow within the company and plan and evaluate material flow systems.
Apply basic knowledge of conveyor technology and warehouse planning.
Present the basics of process and material flow simulation.
Through active participation in the offered logistics management game, consolidate the learned fundamentals in material flow optimization.
Promote students' social competence through group work during a material flow optimization.

syllabus_topics: Simulation of Logistics, Material Flow and Production Systems
Conveyor Technology: Continuous and Discontinuous Conveyors
assessment_rules: The assessment is based on a 60-minute written exam (Klausur). This exam contributes 100% to the module grade.
